title: per-binding snapshot replay 잠금 범위 축소
existingWork: MVKMetal4PreparedBindingSnapshots::replay는 cache mutex 안에서 retain callback을 수행. group snapshot의 밖에서 retain하는 구조는 이미 완료.
missingEvidence: 잠금 경합이나 대기가 실제 병목이라는 증거가 없음.
requiredBoundary: 불변 entry 수명과 동시 교체/삭제 계약 설계 필요.

risk.function: 중간~높음: retain 중 replacement/Miss 시 새 entry를 잘못 erase하지 않아야 함.
risk.lifetime: 높음: mutex 해제 뒤 vectors/node raw pointer 사용 금지; immutable entry 수명 확보 필요.
risk.synchronization: 높음: cache→resource lock 중첩을 줄일 수 있으나 교체/재생/실패 계약 재설계 필요. 현재 deadlock을 발견했다는 뜻 아님.
risk.memory: immutable shared_ptr entry/atomic 참조·메타데이터 할당이 추가될 수 있음.

strategy: Acquire shared immutable entry under mutex, run unchanged live-retain callback outside, and erase on Miss only if exact entry identity still matches. Admitted allocation failure preserves the old map and current native ownership. Replacement adds allocation/refcount cost; concurrently replayed old entries can temporarily exceed the map64 bound.
acceptance: Per-binding mutex contention is established, not inferred from a nested callback
Entry ownership and replace/delete races reviewed jointly with the group8 design
Noncontended path cost and bounded retained memory remain acceptable
tests: Existing snapshot replay fixture with deterministic replacement between lookup/retain/failure cleanup
Stale failed entry must not erase a new entry; old owner survives callback; no dangling pointer
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
